beats.outfit: BriBri in grey tracksuit trousers and his sun-yellow T-shirt with the red stripe on the left of the chest, red sock on his RIGHT foot and yellow sock on his LEFT foot, small soft afro. Kaydoudou in a plain green T-shirt and dark trousers, shaved part on the left, the braided blue and white bracelet on his LEFT wrist.
beats.action: In the middle of the bedroom rug, BriBri imitates Kenzo: both hands lifted to his head as if twirling imaginary curls, chin high, eyelids half closed with a snooty look, shoulders rolling as he struts. On the edge of his bed, Kaydoudou sits hunched with his elbows on his knees, not laughing yet, the corner of his mouth just starting to twitch.
beats.location: The brothers' small bedroom in a third-floor flat in Bussy-Saint-Georges, two beds, a football poster with no writing, a window onto the night and the lit train station below.
beats.light: Warm yellow bedside lamp light in the evening, deep blue night in the window.
beats.camera: Medium shot from the doorway, BriBri strutting in the foreground on the left, Kaydoudou on the bed on the right.
beats.alt: Dans leur chambre, BriBri imite Kenzo en se faisant des boucles imaginaires, et Kaydoudou retient un sourire sur son lit.

beats.anchor: Lacombe prend Kaydoudou par les épaules
beats.extras: Monsieur Bertrand Lacombe, 55, pale skin, short grey hair, a thick grey moustache trimmed like a shoe brush, navy tracksuit, a metal whistle on a lace, both dry hands on Kaydoudou's shoulders. Mathis, 13, a tall U14 defender with pale skin and short dark hair, in a grey ESM training top, standing behind Kaydoudou with his hands on his hips. Two orange training cones on the turf.
beats.outfit: Kaydoudou in his old faded green shirt with the white collar and white number 8, black shorts, white socks, worn black boots, shaved part on the left, the braided blue and white bracelet on his LEFT wrist.
beats.action: Lacombe holds Kaydoudou by both shoulders and turns him a quarter turn sideways, like opening a door. Kaydoudou's face changes as his eyes suddenly take in the whole pitch: the passer in front of him and the open field beyond. Behind him, Mathis watches with a little smirk. A ball rests at Kaydoudou's left foot.
beats.location: The edge of an artificial training pitch at the ESM centre on an October evening.
beats.light: White floodlights at night making the fine rain sparkle like silver dust, cold blue air, warm skin tones.
beats.camera: Medium shot from the side at chest height, the quarter turn readable in the bodies, the bright empty pitch opening on the right.
beats.alt: Sous les projecteurs, Monsieur Lacombe fait pivoter Kaydoudou d'un quart de tour pour lui ouvrir le corps vers le jeu.

beats.anchor: Pfiou ! La passe traverse deux lignes d'un coup.
beats.extras: Kenzo Delattre, 13, brown curls, very white boots, white ESM kit with number 8 on the back, sprinting behind the opposing midfield. Racing Club des Coteaux players, about 13, mixed skin tones, in orange shirts, caught flat-footed in two lines, turning their heads too late.
beats.outfit: Kaydoudou in the white ESM shirt with the star on the heart, seen from the front so no number shows, shaved part on the left, the braided blue and white bracelet on his LEFT wrist. BriBri far ahead in the white ESM shirt with number 7, red sock on his RIGHT foot and yellow sock on his LEFT foot, starting his run toward the far post.
beats.action: Kaydoudou, body open sideways, has just struck the ball with his left foot in one touch; his calm eyes follow it. The ball slices low through a gap between two lines of orange shirts toward Kenzo's run. Far ahead, BriBri is already on his toes, ready to sprint to the far post.
beats.location: A suburban artificial pitch on a grey Saturday, a white rail around it, parents blurred behind, Papa's green, red and yellow scarf a small bright spot in the crowd.
beats.light: Soft grey daylight on a damp pitch, the white kits glowing, sharp motion on the ball.
beats.camera: Dynamic low angle behind and beside Kaydoudou, the line of the pass running diagonally into the depth of the frame, the two orange lines split by it.
beats.alt: Le corps ouvert, Kaydoudou envoie une passe qui traverse deux lignes d'un coup vers la course de Kenzo.
